objective: Increase qualified ERN entry traffic and continuation without changing source truth, ranking or monetization pressure.

experiments.action: When the owner next shares ERN organically, use a small rotation of destination-specific links rather than only the homepage.
experiments.boundary: No claim of causation from one wave; no paid promotion implied.

experiments.action: Track whether previously missing destination clusters become successful searches after truthful sources are added.
experiments.boundary: Never add a weak source to improve the metric.

experiments.action: Measure whether explicit planning links are used after visitors engage with a truthful Earth source.
experiments.boundary: No booking/revenue inference; commercial value cannot affect source ranking.

experiments.action: Keep Travelpayouts Drive site-wide OFF so traffic-quality changes can be measured without automatic keyword/link/recommendation monetization confounding the visitor experience.
measure: organic/referral/search behavior under manual explicit monetization only
experiments.boundary: Future Drive test requires separate owner approval and planning-surface-only scope.

experiments.source: 185 existing searchable destination alias groups; Pages #2942 and #2943 owner-confirmed green
experiments.hypothesis: Destination-specific searches in Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish and romanized place names lead to more qualified Earth opens than generic homepage entry.
metrics: settled search success by query group
releaseConditions: Verify Pages Operations Syntax matching content SHA
Verify real domain Search/Explore and source handoff

guardrails: No affiliate attribution to Earth/source buttons
No claimed conversion from aggregate clicks

experiments.action: Owner-created ERN Facebook Page is linked from About and Media Kit after exact identity review. Shareable island collection provides a focused destination for future owner-managed posts.
experiments.boundary: Page presence and owner sharing are verified observations, not posting-integration activation. No campaign causation, reach, bookings or earnings inferred. No automatic posts, ads or submissions.

successDefinition: More qualified destination entry and continued Earth exploration, with source truth and visitor trust preserved.
